MUS.note: Historical timeline of the weather service; no farming use of satellite data stated.

facts.fact: Mauritius Meteorological Services states it installed Meteosat-based data distribution in 1993, HRPT and PDUS satellite receivers in 1995, and migrated to a new Meteosat-operated satellite data system in 2004.

systems.system: Meteosat satellite data system (MDD, HRPT, PDUS)
